text:
Introduction
This procedure details the
outlines the Inspections activities steps required for the SF6 outdoor Circuit
Breaker 132kv FX11, GEC Alsthom I1, which are performed every Year as
indicated by the Y1,
as indicated in the above titled block.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued
CB must be isolated
 and proper earthing at the both sides of the CB
Interrupt the
 control circuit (DC volt).
Discharges closing
 spring 70.02 and tripping spring 40.04 by operating manual lever trip and
 manual lever close.
Wearing safety
 helmet is required.
Tools and Equipment
Densimeter
 test device W41.
Leak detector W51, Thermometer
 W51.
1
 set of metric open end box wrenches.
Cleaning cloths, Lubricating
 grease.
Work to be carried out
Inspect break insulator (20.02 fig.1) and supporting isolator (30.01
 fig.1) for pollution and any cracks and clean it with dry wipers.
Compare
 the reading of pressure gauge (80.03 fig,1) with filling pressure of CB
 where (filling pressure =Pn
 + ∆P) 
 Pn
 =Rated Pressure (6bar in this case) ∆P
 = Correction value which can be determined using the chart fig (2) 
 according to the
 approximate gas temperature which can
 be defined with using a thermometer (w52 fig.2) closely fitted to the
 CB in shade.
Check the function of heater (70.15 fig.1) and
 check the door gasket of the control cabinet.
Record counter reading of operation counter.
Carryout gas inspection.
